state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has emerged as a prominent destination for frontier technology investments, highlighted by major data center projects from Google and Reliance in Visakhapatnam [R1349768b, R37f1fbdf]. The state government is advancing workforce readiness through large-scale skilling initiatives in partnership with companies like IBM and programs under FutureSkills PRIME [Rb7d37144, R9fe15d9b], alongside plans to establish India's first quantum and AI university campus in Amaravati [R2d894836, R278c90f7]. Furthermore, administrative operations and public services are integrating artificial intelligence across sectors such as tax enforcement, healthcare, policing, and school education [R6e71a6d9, R37bbf64f, R3a304a95, Re98842fe].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through strategic investments, policy rollouts, and multi-sector integration. Major developments include multi-crore Memorandums of Understanding signed at the India AI Impact Summit and a substantial investment by CtrlS for an AI data centre [R44971ae6, Rd3f465ac]. The state has actively incorporated AI across education, healthcare, governance, and infrastructure, establishing partnerships with firms like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and students [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306]. Additionally, administrative frameworks like the paperless e-Cabinet system, AI-driven surveillance, and public service delivery enhancements reflect the state's broader digital transformation [Re986d143, R1c32aa92, Rac954476].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has heavily invested in artificial intelligence infrastructure and digital growth, launching initiatives like the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 targeting green AI capacity, a state-wide GPUaaS framework, and AI centers of excellence in GIFT City [Re041bd74, Rd1b68bba, Ra9ed9573]. The state government has expanded AI applications across public services, implementing tools for paddy quality assessment, drug case management, and police surveillance networks, alongside education programs targeting hundreds of thousands of students [Rd78856c5, R28ccc09b, Ra6932da2, Re71562c3]. At the same time, judicial oversight has emerged regarding AI deployment, with the Gujarat High Court prohibiting its use in judgment drafting and addressing issues with AI-generated case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major initiatives in governance, education, and infrastructure. Key actions include introducing AI curriculum and training programs in government schools starting from early grades, partnering with global tech entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs for public sector innovation, and launching specialized AI centers of excellence alongside large-scale infrastructure projects [R8176ca19, Rff273deb, Re78dfed2]. However, some infrastructure developments like the proposed Bidadi AI township have faced notable resistance from local farmers over land acquisition [Rc8ca4ff7, R85600d54].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem by approving a comprehensive AI Policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and establishing an independent Department of Electronics, IT, and AI [R562864e1, Rbff13ca0]. The state is heavily investing in large-scale infrastructure projects, including an $11 billion Tata AI Innovation City and substantial green data centre partnerships in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region [Rf8ceda95, Re0b416d1]. In governance and public services, the government has deployed sovereign AI tools like Sarvam AI for administrative users, launched specialized AI platforms such as MahaINDUS, and integrated AI applications across policing, agriculture, education, and municipal surveillance [R68fee1a0, R7ec03dda, R04592b70, Rda0dbcb5, R2889d124, Rcc290c50]. Furthermore, authorities have instituted multi-tier governance panels, expert committees, and standardized operating procedures to regulate AI deployments and oversee policy implementation securely [R5afedf9c, R40c3cafc, Rba8badb1].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major industrial investments and infrastructure projects, including partnerships with Sarvam AI for sovereign compute grids and multi-billion-rupee data centre deals with firms like HCLTech and Adani [Rdf1e1271, R31b27cb7, R3a36bb44, Re0acbc4f]. The state has also integrated AI into public administration and citizen services by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Ama Sathi' for revenue and police services, launching automated E-Challan highway systems, and adopting AI surveillance for security and wildlife protection [R478c8c67, R19f1eab3, R8a2dd09f, R499f4234]. Furthermore, Odisha is reforming its education sector by incorporating AI courses into undergraduate, postgraduate, and apprenticeship curricula while establishing specialized tech and robotics labs statewide [Rdb5da3c5, R47f5da8c, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integrations across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state introduced AI into the school curriculum for classes from Class I to XII, established specialized AI labs, and launched AI-driven career guidance [Rf6319e99, R18b7190d, R11fad9f5]. In agriculture and healthcare, partnerships with institutions like IIT Ropar have brought AI-powered weather stations, farming advisories, and early cancer screening devices to the public [R609b6fc5, R85a67327, R8d148d24]. Meanwhile, law enforcement agencies have deployed AI voice recognition systems, automated driving test tracks, and smart cameras to combat organized crime and enhance road safety [R7333c0ad, Re289fcd5, R0422c60c], though judicial and legal bodies have placed certain restrictions on AI usage for judgments and statutory notices [R8eacd504, R3d477cff].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has rolled out extensive policy and budget initiatives to position itself as a leading artificial intelligence economy, featuring plans for a 1,000-acre AI city, a sovereign AI park, and a state-owned GPU cluster [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, Rd301964f]. The state government is actively integrating AI across public governance and infrastructure, deploying WhatsApp chatbots for citizen services, AI surveillance for wildlife conservation, and automated systems for building approvals and agricultural advisories [R576baa19, R9a69237a, R63da60ab, R190ffa0a]. Furthermore, educational and workforce development efforts span from AI training programs for government school teachers and students to introducing specialized trades in Industrial Training Institutes and partnering with academic institutions like IIT Madras [Rfe24cede, R5742a9b1, R305828a2].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has pursued extensive AI-driven initiatives across governance, public services, and infrastructure, marked by the launch of the Telangana AI Innovation Hub and major data center investments [Rd6f74125, R5b4a7a80]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence into law enforcement, taxation, traffic management, and agricultural market monitoring to improve administrative efficiency [Ra1409382, R849548ed, Rce4536fa, R45e372bd]. Additionally, numerous partnerships have been established with technology firms and academic institutions to drive large-scale AI skill development and literacy programs for students and government employees [R998e03d5, R3bfd0d73, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has actively pursued artificial intelligence development through major infrastructure investments, policy frameworks, and multi-sector digital governance initiatives. The state cabinet approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside a Data Centre Policy to support expanding AI and cloud infrastructure through massive proposed investments [Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Landmark initiatives include plans for dedicated robotics and AI hubs in Greater Noida and Lucknow, alongside partnerships for gigawatt-scale data center compute facilities [Rb1cbd4df, R14c6a506, Rad45bc42]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI into public administration, education, and security by launching skill development programs, AI-monitored examinations, and automated fraud-detection tools [R1e320eca, Re0c4ff32, Rd1807ca7].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India are actively formulating comprehensive AI policies, mission frameworks, and major infrastructure investments to drive technological growth. Several states have approved specific funding and policy blueprints, such as Maharashtra's ₹10,000 crore AI policy allocation, Uttar Pradesh's AI mission focusing on startups and skilling, and Chhattisgarh's ₹500 crore AI mission [R562864e1, Rb312992b, R7cc53f61]. At the same time, regional authorities are prioritizing specialized hubs, data center policies, and dedicated tech cities in places like Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh [R1b6cbab3, Rb322fa47, R398131aa]. Beyond infrastructure, state administrations are integrating artificial intelligence into public service delivery, education curricula, governance, and administrative oversight [R8f4114ad, 2c0df2e5, R5c2eec42].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and judiciaries have actively pursued regulatory frameworks and ethical guidelines to manage the adoption of artificial intelligence. Multiple high courts, including those in Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana, have prohibited or restricted the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and legal research [Rbd9766bd, R8eacd504]. Concurrently, administrative bodies are establishing committees and protocols to address data privacy, governance, and misuse, such as Telangana's restrictions on uploading confidential taxpayer data to unauthorized AI platforms [R607d069a, Ra75d01a2] and Karnataka's ethical AI committee formation [R9b3c768e]. States are also addressing societal risks like deepfakes and cyber safety through specialized protocols, advisories, and proposed digital safety rules [Raf4f7b8d, Rc7b7e0d9, R7c216cfc].

category:funding_budget.text: Multiple Indian state governments have channeled substantial public funds and secured large-scale private investments to build AI infrastructure, data centres, and specialized technology missions [Rd731fc75, R7cc53f61, R3eefbde9]. Significant allocations include Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission, Maharashtra's Rs 500 crore agriculture policy and Rs 11.26 crore Sarvam AI rollout, and Uttar Pradesh's multi-crore initiatives encompassing an AI mission and skill development [R7cc53f61, R68fee1a0, R297b1b1d, Rda0dbcb5]. Furthermore, states like Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Jharkhand have attracted massive private sector proposals and MoUs worth tens of thousands of crores for sovereign compute projects and green AI data centres [R657bba09, R3eefbde9, R2269e1a7]. Targeted spending also addresses public services, education, and sector-specific deployments such as wildlife monitoring and smart governance [Re1ef3be9, Radc0ac36, R311c8976].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India are significantly scaling up their AI infrastructure through major investments in data centres, AI cities, and specialized tech parks [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, Rb1cbd4df]. Prominent initiatives include multi-gigawatt data centre campuses, sovereign AI parks, and compute hubs launched through high-value Memorandums of Understanding and policy frameworks in states like Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, and Telangana [R5b4a7a80, R472c3c1a, R212c0bcb, Re041bd74]. Additionally, states are establishing advanced research facilities, public AI universities, and regional Centers of Excellence to bolster local deep-tech ecosystems and digital skilling [Rc16dddf8, Re78dfed2, R6f55ee54]. These comprehensive developments highlight a nationwide push to integrate high-performance computing, green energy solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities [R3eefbde9, Rb99e617b, R43f4ae2b].

category:partnership.text: State governments have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with tech giants, academic institutions, and industry leaders to boost artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and investments [Rfbc41323, R1349768b, Reff5d158]. States like Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Uttar Pradesh have signed major agreements ranging from massive hyperscale AI data center campuses to skill development and educational initiatives [R1349768b, Reb7bfdb3, Reff5d158, R25e04031, Rf4058825]. Additionally, several regions are integrating AI into public services, healthcare, and governance through targeted collaborations with entities such as Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic [R223baf38, R65d60606, R494484b4]. These partnership drives underscore a nationwide push by state administrations to position themselves as regional technology and deep-tech innovation hubs [R65d2a417, R1349768b, Rd71e810d].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across governance, public services, law enforcement, and welfare delivery. States like Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh have integrated AI tools for administrative workflows, tax monitoring, and examination surveillance [R04592b70, R68fee1a0, Re0c4ff32]. Additionally, several states are launching AI-powered chat bots and voice portals to improve citizen access to healthcare, education, and revenue services [R27258895, Rccf3ba89, R576baa19]. Law enforcement and disaster management have also seen substantial AI adoption through automated video analytics, crime tracking systems, and early warning platforms [R7333c0ad, Ra460605d, R84d949ed].

category:skilling.text: State governments have heavily prioritized artificial intelligence skilling initiatives targeting both students and teachers across various educational levels. Multiple states, including Punjab, Karnataka, and Tripura, have introduced AI curricula and early tech training in government schools [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R3fff65a8]. Furthermore, large-scale training programs and industry partnerships with entities like Google and Microsoft have been launched to educate millions of youth and thousands of teachers [Reb7bfdb3, Rb312992b, R2889d124]. States such as Uttar Pradesh and Telangana have rolled out extensive missions to skill hundreds of thousands of students in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud computing [Rb312992b, R6843cc3b, Rc6148c8c].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments have actively engaged stakeholders through numerous AI-focused summits, conclaves, and tech expos to drive innovation, investment, and digital governance [Rf73e4f3d, Rec3b838b, Reb9a8d36]. Major events like the India AI Impact Summit and regional conferences have seen states sign partnership agreements, showcase technological deployments, and promote skills development [R84a7e58c, R4348031c, R4d3bfbb9]. Additionally, hackathons and workshops targeting sectors such as agriculture, policing, healthcare, and education have been widely organized to foster practical AI applications and youth engagement [R28ccc09b, Rb77a4651, Rd2cc8ca5].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has aggressively advanced its AI policy and governance framework by rebranding its IT department to focus on artificial intelligence and future technologies [Ref58a154, R0182578b]. The state launched several major institutional initiatives, including AI Centres of Excellence [Rcaa18758, Rd47ca5ca], a Malayalam AI Mission [R1db5da2a], and a massive investment agreement for an AI data centre [Ra525c46d]. Furthermore, administrative reforms span diverse sectors such as AI-driven public service delivery, disaster management, policing, and education [R8f4114ad, R3391f5dc, R9147ba4b, R70e049dc].

category:governance_body.text: State governments across India have established dedicated governance bodies, ministries, and specialized committees to oversee artificial intelligence policy and deployment. Notable initiatives include Kerala and Tamil Nadu appointing dedicated AI ministers and restructuring their information technology departments to focus on AI and future technologies [R6bbe2d82, Ref58a154, Ref475c84]. Additionally, states like Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Bihar have formed multi-tiered panels, expert committees, and district-level cells to handle ethical AI usage, higher education integration, and land-revenue monitoring [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, Ra3ee576b]. Law enforcement and security agencies in states such as Telangana, Haryana, West Bengal, and Jharkhand have similarly constituted specialized AI task forces and tech teams to drive digital policing [Ra1409382, Ra6b5d331, R6e827395, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Indian state governments have widely pursued artificial intelligence initiatives across infrastructure, governance, and education sectors since late 2025. States such as Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Bihar have formally approved comprehensive AI policies or driven major funding commitments and investment MoUs to strengthen local tech ecosystems [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, R44971ae6]. Significant investments are flowing into large-scale data center infrastructure and specialized tech hubs, exemplified by major corporate projects and proposed AI cities in states like Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Telangana [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80]. Simultaneously, states are actively integrating AI into public administration, law enforcement, and judicial frameworks through automated workflows, police copilots, and digital portals [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rbd9766bd]. Educational reforms are also prominent, with multiple states introducing AI learning programmes, tech training, and skill development initiatives for students and teachers in government schools [Rf6319e99, R27258895, Rc119f335].

state:Assam.text: Assam is actively advancing artificial intelligence across public governance, infrastructure, and services, marked by the commissioning of its first government-owned GPU cluster and the mapping of hundreds of governance proposals [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. The state has integrated AI into critical sectors such as education through teacher training programs and automated attendance systems, healthcare via patient monitoring and plans for robotic surgeries, and environmental management through flood rescue platforms and wildlife protection [R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c, Rdc188dd0, R9c52da90, Ra093ebca]. Partnerships with entities like Google and UNICEF further support capacity building and digital infrastructure development across departments [Red858166, R39b50ddb].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is aggressively advancing its digital economy and technological capabilities through the Chhattisgarh AI Mission, which includes a ₹500 crore allocation over five years and plans for a major AI data center park in Nava Raipur [R7cc53f61, Recb4eed4, R63bfb6f9]. The state has launched large-scale educational initiatives, partnering with Google to train two lakh teachers in AI-enabled tools and introducing specialized coding, robotics, and machine learning modules for rural and tribal students [R398fad0d, R1445ea1e]. Furthermore, artificial intelligence is being extensively integrated into public administration and security, ranging from AI-powered surveillance systems for wildlife conservation and rural road monitoring to automated fraud detection and policing tools [Reb028d74, R8958cba0, R1dec6260, R6c86e7f3].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana is actively advancing its AI-driven governance and digital infrastructure by integrating artificial intelligence across sectors such as public administration, healthcare, and education [R127f881c, R03b25e4d]. Key initiatives include establishing AI hubs and digital colleges in Gurugram and Panchkula, leveraging AI tools for tuberculosis screening and financial fraud prevention, and modernizing police capabilities to tackle cybercrime [R0a41f591, R770d942f, Re984ab2a]. The state is also reforming education by introducing AI, robotics, and vocational training in schools and ITIs, while partnering with organizations like the World Bank to support its overarching AI mission [Rcd5e27a7, R01ac3f97, R2bca6acc].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, education, and resource management to enhance governance and service delivery [Re82f2564]. The state has introduced AI-driven tools for student learning like the 'Padhai with AI' app, expanded AI and data science courses in higher education, and enrolled teachers in digital skill baseline programs [Rb23a865a, R17bda009, Rc9d96f12]. Furthermore, AI applications are being deployed for forest resource mapping, disaster risk mitigation, healthcare fraud detection, and law enforcement [Rd81af6f6, R26835c79, Rc3a3d3b4, R61e5504f].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its technology landscape by launching the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026, which targets over 10,000 crore in private investments and aims to generate more than one lakh AI jobs [Rb9553546, R4b4e0b34]. The state is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, healthcare, and education, through initiatives like AI-powered portals, smart classes, and training programs [R93418e63, Rb7cd9ee5, R95bbe8d6]. Additionally, the government has deployed AI applications for wildlife monitoring, public safety at major events, and infrastructure management [R96eaad17, Re675872a, Rde702427].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is rapidly expanding artificial intelligence applications across governance, infrastructure, and public services, backed by major investments and strategic partnerships [R005881fc, R6473839f]. The state has leveraged AI for financial oversight and public procurement monitoring, successfully detecting irregularities and municipal purchase anomalies [R37a735c1, R4c96f220]. Significant technological advancements also include AI-driven surveillance systems for security and crowd management at major religious gatherings like Simhastha 2028, alongside extensive deployments in public healthcare, tourism, and law enforcement [R12d4ab71, R583299ef, R085470af].

state:Manipur.text: The state of Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public sector domains, highlighted by initiatives in digital governance, cybersecurity, and tribal welfare [R8e91e0e8, Rdc31ca32, Re9f95033]. Significant partnerships include an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to expand multilingual AI, as well as collaborations with Microsoft [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. Furthermore, academic and institutional efforts have advanced AI applications through workshops, research colloquiums, and the launch of translation tools like the 'Ishaan' app [R49d826c3, R546f135d, R13590541]. Other notable developments involve exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking and focusing on digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public services, highlighted by initiatives such as drafting a new IT policy focusing on AI and global capability centres [R9625f972]. Significant actions include launching the AI-powered CM IMPACT guidebook [R5f7260ed], proposing an AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park [Rf277c3a3], and partnering with Wadhwani AI to deploy solutions in agriculture and education [Rf1f88f85]. The state has also introduced interactive AI learning in schools [R24be49c9], showcased its edGrid governance tool [R73c7e0d9], and utilized data-driven governance to improve public health outcomes [R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has focused heavily on establishing a comprehensive technological ecosystem by announcing plans to launch a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence and advanced digital tools across multiple sectors, including deploying AI-powered school monitoring systems, robotics labs in schools, and AI X-Ray machines in healthcare [R2235629e, R20047d48, R311a6da8]. Additionally, leadership has promoted workforce readiness through targeted AI skill initiatives, employment-focused training for women, and specialized educational programs like NIELIT Agartala's B.Tech in AI and Machine Learning [R3fff65a8, Rb70cb3d9, Rc67b1e1a].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, including governance, education, and environmental management. State initiatives feature mandatory AI education across universities [Rcea6d545], AI-powered wildlife and forest monitoring systems [R994e0e10, R82962675], and technology-driven public service delivery like cyber crime helpline agents [R549f779d]. Additionally, the government has adopted AI tools to curb tax evasion [Recb1f69d], secure major events [R9dac4ef2], and preserve regional languages through specialized voice portals [R3158dd4a].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively driving AI-led industrial growth, supported by policy reforms, the Silicon Valley Project, and a draft industrial policy that focuses on MSMEs, data centres, and semiconductors [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R1ada3e48]. The state is also integrating artificial intelligence into governance, law enforcement, and civic services through dedicated police AI cells, investigative apps, AI-powered helplines, and urban infrastructure exploration [R6e827395, Rebcdd9ec, R904a08ab, R08e415eb]. Furthermore, educational and workforce development initiatives are expanding rapidly, featuring school modernization drives, coding and robotics curriculums, and partnerships with organizations like Oracle to upskill thousands of students [Rf61a82a3, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has advanced its AI policy landscape by approving the AI-ML Policy 2026 and launching an official AI Foundational Course to empower citizens [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. The state has extensively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, deploying AI for public grievance redressal on the Sampark platform, facial recognition for security, and automated traffic management systems [Rd7e6b721, Rcaf01e51, R0af96cb6]. Additionally, AI applications are being utilized in agriculture for crop monitoring and services through partnerships with Wadhwani AI, as well as in healthcare for tracking diabetes treatment and medical audits [R6de84b70, Rb6d56877, Ra1a22ff0].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland's AI policy activity spans across infrastructure development, education reforms, and governance initiatives. Key actions include the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling [R6f55ee54], the unveiling of the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness [Ra8c17a13], and the launch of an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem [R3a286812]. Additionally, the state has focused on educational and capacity-building measures, such as planning an AI curriculum from Class 6 [R8b9ea930], hosting workshops and hackathons [R212a4f6f], and launching a WhatsApp chatbot to improve access to skill development services [R1ee21379].
